v1.0.2

- Added security documentation and test result reports.
- Introduced a detailed security fix report (v2.0.1).
- Included a formal LICENSE file.
- Packaged and documented the latest submission.

- Initial release of ZhenCap Investment Analysis Assistant as an OpenClaw MCP skill.
- Provides AI-powered market size estimation, competitor SWOT analysis, valuation modeling, and multi-dimensional risk scoring.
- All functionality delivered via API to the ZhenCap cloud; no local document processing.
- Supports a free tier (50 API calls/month); paid usage available with API key.
- Tools and usage fully documented with setup, configuration, and troubleshooting guidance.

OpenClaw Venture Capitalist 1.0.0 – initial release.

- Analyze business plans and pitch decks to extract key metrics and insights.
- Automatically generate comprehensive investment analysis reports and IC presentation decks.
- Compare multiple investment opportunities side-by-side.
- Extract specific fields (e.g., market size, team, financials) from documents.
- Customizable analysis framework and scoring via configuration file.
- Outputs available in markdown, PDF, DOCX, and presentation formats.
